# Piové Cosmetics

> Piové Cosmetics is an online beauty and makeup store serving customers across Algeria.

## Key Pages
- [Homepage](https://piovecosmetics.com/): Discover Piové Cosmetics and its beauty collections.
- [Shop](https://piovecosmetics.com/shop): Browse makeup, skincare, and beauty products.
- [Delivery](https://piovecosmetics.com/livraison): Learn about delivery across Algeria.
- [FAQ](https://piovecosmetics.com/faq): Find answers to common customer questions.
- [About](https://piovecosmetics.com/about): Learn more about Piové Cosmetics.
- [Contact](https://piovecosmetics.com/contact): Contact the Piové Cosmetics team.
- [Terms and conditions](https://piovecosmetics.com/conditions): Review the terms for using the store.
- [Privacy policy](https://piovecosmetics.com/confidentialite): Read the privacy policy.
